page.notes: Marginal label "Qvæst. XIV." transcribed as one note; printed as two lines (QVÆST. / XIV.). Italic and roman distinctions in the dense blurred lines are approximate. "Bar[?]klaium" is doubtful: the printed form may be Barclaium. The verse spellings "Romae" and "Romæ" are unclear. "cœlum" and "Denique" are as seen. The line "mis" at lower right is the catchword, completing "gravissimis" on the next page. The last line of text ends on the half word "gravissi-". Page is slightly blurred; the reading of "Espensæus" and "Panitentiariæ" should be checked against the original.
